findings.issue: Storage key derived from empty email field on initial load causes data loss for returning users
findings.details: The auto-save mechanism uses formData.sectionA.email to create the localStorage key. On first visit, email is empty, so data saves to 'udan_diaspora_form_udan_diaspora_form'. When user enters email and continues, subsequent saves go to the new email-based key. On return visit, the form tries to load from the original key and cannot find previously saved data. This violates the requirement for reliable auto-save on every field change.
findings.userImpact: Returning users lose all previously saved form data if they don't enter their email first
findings.fix: Use a constant storage key independent of email (e.g., 'udan_diaspora_form_draft'), or integrate with user authentication to pre-fill email before determining the storage key

findings.issue: Missing 'Save & Continue Later' button required by specification
findings.details: The requirement explicitly calls for a 'Save & Continue Later' button to allow users to exit the form without completing it. The current implementation only has implicit auto-save with Previous/Next/Submit buttons. There is no explicit button for users to save and leave.
findings.userImpact: Users have no clear way to save their progress and exit the form. No visual confirmation of save.
findings.fix: Add a dedicated 'Save & Continue Later' button that provides user confirmation the data has been saved and allows them to navigate away from the form
